criteria.name: Non-text Content
criteria.part: alt and long descriptions rendered; chrome icons named. Content: alt text (the XSD requires alt)

criteria.name: Audio-only and Video-only
criteria.part: transcript cards and alternatives rendered. Content: the alternatives

criteria.name: Captions (Prerecorded)
criteria.part: track kind="captions" shown; PNP captions on

criteria.name: Audio Description or Media Alternative
criteria.part: description tracks and audio-description cards

criteria.name: Captions (Live)
criteria.part: N/A: no live media

criteria.name: Info and Relationships
criteria.part: semantic HTML from BodyNodes; native controls or ARIA patterns per interaction; table headers

criteria.name: Meaningful Sequence
criteria.part: DOM order is view order; the CSS never reorders reading order

criteria.name: Sensory Characteristics
criteria.part: messages never rely on shape, color or position alone

criteria.name: Orientation
criteria.part: no orientation lock

criteria.name: Identify Input Purpose
criteria.part: N/A: the player collects no personal data (login is the host's)
criteria.notApplicable: the player collects no personal data (login is the host's)

criteria.name: Use of Color
criteria.part: selected, invalid and flagged states have a non-color cue

criteria.name: Audio Control
criteria.part: no audio plays more than 3 s without a pause or stop control; autostart media keep their controls

criteria.name: Contrast (Minimum)
criteria.part: every theme of player.css, the PNP color themes included, at least 4.5:1

criteria.name: Resize Text
criteria.part: 200% zoom without loss

criteria.name: Images of Text
criteria.part: the chrome uses text. Content: images of text
criteria.manual: review of the chrome for images of text

criteria.name: Reflow
criteria.part: 320 CSS px wide without two-dimensional scrolling for the chrome and text content; graphic interactions are two-dimensional content

criteria.name: Non-text Contrast
criteria.part: focus rings, control borders and hotspot outlines at least 3:1

criteria.name: Text Spacing
criteria.part: no clipping under the WCAG text-spacing values

criteria.name: Content on Hover or Focus
criteria.part: glossary and keyword-translation popups: dismissible with Escape, hoverable, persistent

criteria.name: Keyboard
criteria.part: every interaction, tool and control by keyboard
criteria.evidence: K for every interaction and tool

criteria.name: No Keyboard Trap
criteria.part: focus enters and leaves PCI and LTI frames; dialogs return focus

criteria.name: Character Key Shortcuts
criteria.part: no single-character shortcuts
criteria.evidence: M; unit test of key handlers

criteria.name: Timing Adjustable
criteria.part: timed exams use the essential exception; PNP additional time; warnings 300 and 60 s before a limit through a live region

criteria.name: Pause, Stop, Hide
criteria.part: the only moving content is the timer, which the candidate can hide; content media have controls

criteria.name: Three Flashes or Below Threshold
criteria.part: the player never flashes. Content: hazard avoidance withholds flashing media (T95)

criteria.name: Bypass Blocks
criteria.part: a skip link to the item; landmarks

criteria.name: Page Titled
criteria.part: the page is the host's; the view gives test and item titles for it
criteria.notApplicable: the page is the host's; the view gives test and item titles for it

criteria.name: Focus Order
criteria.part: focus moves to the item heading on navigation; dialogs keep and restore focus

criteria.name: Link Purpose (In Context)
criteria.part: chrome links named. Content: link text

criteria.name: Multiple Ways
criteria.part: N/A: a test is a process, an exception of the criterion
criteria.notApplicable: a test is a process, an exception of the criterion

criteria.name: Headings and Labels
criteria.part: item and section headings; a label for every control

criteria.name: Focus Visible
criteria.part: :focus-visible rings in every theme

criteria.name: Focus Not Obscured (Minimum)
criteria.part: answer masking, the line reader, magnification, sticky chrome and popups never hide the focused element entirely; scroll-margin keeps it clear

criteria.name: Pointer Gestures
criteria.part: no path or multipoint gesture is required; drawing has click-placed shapes

criteria.name: Pointer Cancellation
criteria.part: activation on the up event; drags can be aborted

criteria.name: Label in Name
criteria.part: visible labels are part of accessible names
criteria.evidence: axe label-content-name-mismatch, enabled explicitly because it is experimental and off by default (d-m8)

criteria.name: Motion Actuation
criteria.part: N/A: no motion input

criteria.name: Dragging Movements
criteria.part: every drag (order, match, gap match, graphic gap match, position object, rule, protractor) has a select-then-place alternative

criteria.name: Target Size (Minimum)
criteria.part: targets at least 24 by 24 CSS px: chrome, choices, tool controls; hotspots get a 24 px hit area or the spacing exception; select point has a keyboard crosshair

criteria.name: Language of Page
criteria.part: the root's lang from the interface language; the page's <html lang> is the host's

criteria.name: Language of Parts
criteria.part: content lang and xml:lang kept

criteria.name: On Focus
criteria.part: no change of context on focus

criteria.name: On Input
criteria.part: no change of context on input; navigation only by explicit actions

criteria.name: Consistent Navigation
criteria.part: the chrome's order is fixed
criteria.manual: review of the order of the chrome

criteria.name: Consistent Identification
criteria.part: one message key per function

criteria.name: Consistent Help
criteria.part: a help slot, if the host fills it, at one place

criteria.name: Error Identification
criteria.part: refusals and validity messages in text, tied to the control (aria-describedby, aria-invalid)

criteria.name: Labels or Instructions
criteria.part: prompts, labels and constraints (min and max choices, pattern messages) shown

criteria.name: Error Suggestion
criteria.part: validity hints say how to fix (data-*-message or catalog text)

criteria.name: Error Prevention (Legal, Financial, Data)
criteria.part: the criterion covers submitting test responses: confirmation before end-part, end-test and a linear submit; review in nonlinear parts

criteria.name: Redundant Entry
criteria.part: N/A: nothing is entered twice

criteria.name: Accessible Authentication (Minimum)
criteria.part: N/A: authentication is the host's; LTI launches need no cognitive test
criteria.notApplicable: authentication is the host's; LTI launches need no cognitive test

criteria.name: Name, Role, Value
criteria.part: custom elements expose native controls or ARIA roles and states; PCI and LTI frames titled

criteria.name: Status Messages
criteria.part: refusals, validity hints, autosave and timer warnings in role="status" regions, without moving focus
